runs.label: complete-export
argv:
SET autoinstall_known_extensions=false; SET autoload_known_extensions=false; SET threads=1; SET memory_limit='128MB'; CREATE TABLE parcels AS SELECT * FROM read_csv('input/parcels.csv',columns={'parcel_id':'VARCHAR','route':'VARCHAR','promised_days':'INTEGER','status':'VARCHAR','actual_days':'INTEGER'},header=true);
DESCRIBE parcels; SELECT status,count(*) AS records FROM parcels GROUP BY status ORDER BY status; SELECT route,count(*) AS delivered_late FROM parcels WHERE status='delivered' AND actual_days>promised_days GROUP BY route ORDER BY route; COPY (SELECT parcel_id,route,promised_days,actual_days,actual_days-promised_days AS days_late FROM parcels WHERE status='delivered' AND actual_days>promised_days ORDER BY parcel_id) TO 'output/late-followup.csv' (HEADER,DELIMITER ','); COPY (SELECT parcel_id,route,promised_days,actual_days,actual_days-promised_days AS days_late FROM parcels WHERE status='delivered' AND actual_days>promised_days ORDER BY parcel_id) TO 'output/late-followup.parquet' (FORMAT PARQUET); SELECT count(*) AS exported_rows FROM read_csv('output/late-followup.csv');

runs.label: parquet-readback
argv: SET autoinstall_known_extensions=false; SET autoload_known_extensions=false; COPY (SELECT * FROM 'output/late-followup.parquet' ORDER BY parcel_id) TO 'output/parquet-readback.csv' (HEADER,DELIMITER ',');
